name: LexiCon Gaming Convention
blurb: Lexington's player-run tabletop convention with a 1,000+ title game library, board game tournaments and tabletop RPG sessions all weekend.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'LexiCon 2027 ... Apr 30 – May 2, 2027 | Clarion Hotel, Lexington, KY' with a live countdown to that date.

notes: No guest program found on the homepage or Events page: the convention is organized entirely around a shared game library, player-run tournaments (Tiny Towns, Take 5, Ticket to Ride, Splendor...) and RPG sessions (Pathfinder, D&D 5e, Starfinder, Blood on the Clocktower), with no mention of invited guests/designers anywhere on the site, so guests is set to 'none' rather than 'none-yet'.
